append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1631). Premise re-tested on main at c8ad9fae2: isCriteriaMet returned false for welcome_member unconditionally, UserStats had no welcome count, and isRelevantEvent checked the badge on post_create. The Crew catalogue line is "Be the first to welcome 5 new members" (achievement welcomer, seeded 20240118000000, criterion welcome_member count 5), and the welcome act already exists: recordWelcome (ADR-186 P3b) inserts one welcomes row per (welcomer, newcomer). FIX: GamificationEvent gains welcome_member; recordWelcome fires it for the welcomer after the welcomes insert lands (a refused or duplicate insert returns first); isRelevantEvent checks the badge on that event only; isCriteriaMet compares firstWelcomeCount (countFirstWelcomes over the welcomes table: newcomers no one welcomed earlier, a same-instant tie counts for both) to the badge count, read only on a welcome_member event, fail-safe 0. No migration, no economy value changed: the badge pays its catalogue zaps_reward (seeded 25) in gems per ADR-139. TESTS: lib/achievements.test.ts (first-welcome counting, unlock on the fifth, none at four, a post neither checks the badge nor reads welcomes) and lib/connections/welcomes.test.ts (a landed welcome fires the event after the gem; refused and duplicate inserts do not; a failed check keeps the welcome). Production holds 0 welcomes rows (orchestrator reading, 2026-09-29), so no badge is owed from before the change. DOCS (owner ruling 2026-09-29 ~19:35Z, "5 gems, fix the docs"): content/help/the-quest/zaps-and-gems.md and docs/REWARDS-ECONOMY.md now say a welcome pays 5 gems once per newcomer (connection_settings.reward_welcome via recordWelcome; the gem_config welcome_member row, 8 at 3 a day, pays nothing), and docs/ONBOARDING-BUILD-LIST.md §1.2 drops the dead chores-actions.ts path for lib/connections/welcomes.ts.
